subject: MAP: Define acceptance & smoke-test schedule for HealthNova pilot
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kelley <sara@healthnova.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP proposal — initial acceptance thresholds and smoke tests

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan for the HealthNova pilot (HN-4892) along with a companion smoke-test script. I summarized the critical acceptance signals below so we have a compact checklist you can share with the team / procurement.

Quick summary (high level):
- Pilot window: 4 weeks (canary week + 3-week validation)
- Primary success signals: functional correctness on the 250-case validation set, mean latency (p95) < 350ms for search/response flows, and end-to-end error rate < 1%
- Quality threshold: concordance >= 92% against the labeled validation set (see evidence_sampling.csv)
- Economic guardrail: average inference cost per 1k requests <= $2.50 (we'll track tokens and batching impact)

Exit gates / acceptance tests (detailed in HN_MAP_v1.xlsx):
1) Smoke pass: core flows run end-to-end with no hard errors (smoke_test_scripts.md)
2) Data fidelity: sampled outputs meet concordance threshold on the labeled set
3) Latency SLA: sustained p95 under 350ms during normal traffic profile
4) Stability: no regression-triggered errors across 48 hours of sustained load at projected volume

Owners and timing:
- Redwood (test automation + runtime metrics): Marcus / Grace
- HealthNova (validation set & business sign-off): Sara + Procurement as needed

Next asks: please confirm these thresholds (especially the concordance target and latency tolerance) and whether procurement needs the MAP attached to the SOW or a separate Annex. I attached the MAP workbook and the initial smoke test markdown.

If that looks good we'll lock the canary week (target week of 2026-07-06) and hand off the DocuSign SOW trigger once procurement confirms the annex.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: HN_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), smoke_test_scripts.md (smoke script), evidence_sampling.csv (sample labels)
From: Sara Kelley <sara@healthnova.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@healthnova.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal — initial acceptance thresholds and smoke tests

On Mon, Jun 7, 2026 at 9:12 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan for the HealthNova pilot (HN-4892) along with a companion smoke-test script.

Marcus — thanks for the concise plan. A couple of clarifications from our side before we circulate to procurement: 

1) Concordance definition: is the 92% concordance strict token-level match, or is it label-level equivalence on the 250-case set? We need the metric defined precisely for legal/procurement.
2) Latency baseline: our internal app expects under 300ms p95 during normal working hours. Is 350ms a hard minimum or a negotiable buffer?
3) Dataset ownership: we will provide the labeled validation set but need Redwood to sign an evidence handling addendum (small item for procurement).

Procurement is CC'd — they may ask for the MAP as an Annex to the SOW. If you can provide a one-page acceptance appendix that we can attach to the SOW, that will speed procurement. Also please note our tentative procurement review meeting on 6/11.

Best,
Sara Kelley
Head of Product Operations | HealthNova
sara@healthnova.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kelley <sara@healthnova.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@healthnova.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal — initial acceptance thresholds and smoke tests

Sara — thanks, great questions. Quick answers and an updated plan below.

1) Concordance definition: label-level equivalence on the 250-case validation set (we score at the case-level and report percent agreement). We'll include the exact scoring script and a reproducible notebook in the Drive folder.
2) Latency baseline: we can commit to p95 < 300ms for the normal working-hours profile as an acceptance gate. We'll keep 350ms as a fallback trigger for extended traffic tests, but the pass/fail for acceptance will be 300ms.
3) Evidence handling addendum: Neha is looped in — she will draft the short addendum and send to your procurement contact.

Updated acceptance checklist (final candidate):
- Smoke: core APIs return successful responses for 100% of scripted examples
- Quality: label-level concordance >= 92% on the 250-case validation set (artifact: evidence_sampling.csv + scoring notebook)
- Latency: p95 < 300ms during normal hours (measured over 72h window)
- Resilience: <1% error rate and no spike >3x baseline during a 48h sustained-run stress test
- Economics: average inference cost <= $2.50 per 1k requests over pilot (monitored daily)

Roll / rollback triggers:
- Immediate rollback if error rate > 5% or if data leakage/sensitivity issue is detected
- Roll-forward allowed if micro-fixes reduce error rate to <1% within 6 business hours during canary

Attached: I updated HN_MAP_v1.xlsx (tab: acceptance_summary) and added a one-page Acceptance Appendix that your procurement can attach to the SOW. Grace — can you validate the smoke_test_scripts.md steps and own the automation run during canary?

Neha will send the evidence-handling addendum draft to Procure for signature (Procurement Team), then we can confirm DocuSign timing. Proposed canary week still target: 2026-07-06.

Thanks — Marcus
From: Sara Kelley <sara@healthnova.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@healthnova.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal — initial acceptance thresholds and smoke tests

On Tue, Jun 9, 2026 at 8:45 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Updated acceptance checklist (final candidate): ...

Marcus / Grace / Neha — this looks good and aligns with what product + security expected. Procurement: the one-page Acceptance Appendix is sufficient as an Annex; please route the evidence-handling addendum to me and cc procurement. Once the addendum is signed we will execute the SOW and confirm the canary week (target 7/6).

Procurement note: we expect final review on 6/11, and if no blockers we will circulate the DocuSign envelope the same day for signature. Sara will sign operational acceptance after the 3-week validation window; CFO will sign the commercial close.

Action items agreed:
- Neha: send evidence-handling addendum to procure@healthnova.com by EOD 6/10 (owner)
- Grace: finalize automated smoke runbook and share runbook link in Drive (owner)
- Marcus: push final MAP workbook (HN_MAP_v1.xlsx) + one-page acceptance appendix to Drive and HubSpot (owner)
- Sara: confirm the 250-case validation set delivery ETA (expected 6/18)

Thanks everyone — will proceed with procurement review on 6/11.

Best,
Sara Kelley
